summary: talkSPORT previews a packed Saturday of sport on October 21, 2023, led by the Merseyside derby at Anfield and including Premier League fixtures, a Rugby World Cup semi-final, a Cricket World Cup match and UFC 294. It covers form, injuries and records for each fixture, with Liverpool heavy favourites over Everton and England's cricketers under pressure.
one_line: talkSPORT previews Saturday 21 October 2023: Merseyside derby, Chelsea vs Arsenal, England vs South Africa in rugby and cricket, and UFC 294.
key_facts: Liverpool sit fourth in the Premier League with five wins from their opening eight games, but lost to Tottenham and drew with Brighton before the international break.
Andy Robertson is out for Liverpool with a shoulder injury picked up on international duty with Scotland.
Everton were winless in their first five games but have since won two; they have won just one of the last 25 Merseyside derbies.
Liverpool vs Everton is live on talkSPORT at 12:30pm on October 21.
Newcastle beat Paris Saint-Germain 4-1 in the Champions League and knocked Manchester City out of the Carabao Cup, but drew 0-0 in all three meetings with Crystal Palace last season.
Sandro Tonali is available for Newcastle despite illegal betting allegations that led to him being sent home from Italy's squad; Joe Willock and Harvey Barnes are injured.
Crystal Palace have kept four clean sheets and sit ninth, one place behind eighth-placed Newcastle.
Arsenal have won six of their last seven meetings with Chelsea, won their last three at Stamford Bridge, and haven't lost a London derby since May 2022.
Arsenal may be without Bukayo Saka and William Saliba; Chelsea are unsure about Reece James and Armando Broja.
Sheffield United are bottom with one point and host tenth-placed Manchester United at 8:00pm; United recently beat Brentford.
England face South Africa in the Rugby World Cup semi-final in Paris from 8:00pm after beating Fiji in the quarter-finals.
England's cricketers face South Africa in Mumbai from 9:30am after losses to Afghanistan and New Zealand; Ben Stokes is fit, and South Africa lost to the Netherlands.
At UFC 294 in Abu Dhabi, Islam Makhachev (24-1-0) defends his lightweight title against Alexander Volkanovski, whom he beat by unanimous decision in February.
Kamaru Usman fights Khamzat Chimaev in a middleweight title eliminator at UFC 294.
